lines.beaver: 민수 씨, 한국 문화에 대해 알려 줄래요?
lines.beaver_en: Minsu, can you tell me about Korean culture?
lines.beaver_roman: Minsu ssi, hanguk munhwae daehae allyeo jullaeyo?
lines.en: Sure. I'll introduce Korean culture to you.

lines.beaver_en: What do you do on holidays?
lines.en: We wear hanbok and play yut with family.

lines.learner: 아니요, 막대 네 개만 던지면 돼서 쉬워요.
lines.en: No, you just throw four sticks, so it's easy.
lines.roman: Aniyo, makdae ne gaeman deonjimyeon dwaeseo swiwoyo.

lines.en: King Sejong made it in the Joseon era.

lines.learner: 아니요, 며칠이면 읽을 수 있어요. 쉬워요.
lines.en: No, you can read it in a few days. It's easy.
lines.roman: Aniyo, myeochirimyeon ilgeul su isseoyo. Swiwoyo.

lines.beaver_en: What are the red and blue in the middle of the flag?
lines.en: Red means yang, and blue means yin.

lines.beaver_en: What religions are there in Korea?
Is it very different from Western culture?
lines.learner: 네, 한국은 유교의 영향을 많이 받았어요.
lines.en: Yes, Korea was greatly influenced by Confucianism.
lines.roman: Ne, hangugeun yugyoui yeonghyangeul mani badasseoyo.

lines.beaver: 문화와 전통에 대해 더 이야기해 볼래요?
lines.beaver_en: Shall we talk more about culture and tradition?
lines.beaver_roman: Munhwawa jeontonge daehae deo iyagihae bollaeyo?
lines.learner: 좋아요. 다음에 한복 가게에 같이 가요.
lines.en: Sure. Let's go to a hanbok shop together next time.
lines.roman: Joayo. Daeume hanbok gagee gachi gayo.

lines.beaver_en: Great! Today was really fun. Thank you.
lines.en: Me too. Please teach me about Western culture too.
